lists.label: Business setup checklist
lists.holds: One row per stage of setting the business up; this workflow writes the replies row.

lists.label: Business setup gaps
lists.holds: One row per thing a stage could not do itself: the step, what was left undecided, what the run did and the evidence.

values.undecided: No live tool sends an Instagram direct-message reply.
values.chosen: Handed 3 checked replies to the person to send by hand.
values.evidence: The live catalog has no send tool for Instagram direct messages.

values.chosen: Submitted status needs_login and pulled nothing.

alike: a blockers column on a board

lists.label: Word checks
lists.holds: One rule for every line a person reads; a reply that breaks an On rule is rewritten before it is handed over.

values.says: No hype words in a reply.
because: replies read as a person, not an ad

values.says: Never promise a result or a date the business has not set.
because: a promise in a DM is a promise

no_lists_because: The item names no list in its own words, input or steps, so it has no example rows to ship.
instructions: 1. Make sure the facts row record:business-setup:facts exists (workflow:set-up-a-business-on-trillion writes it) with channels, posts_per_day (1 to 5) and owner_name; pour the example word checks into your own rules list (see pour) or make list:word-checks from them.

2. Say "Run workflow:post-on-social-channels-on-a-schedule". The AI starts it with tool:start-a-recipe-run and works the steps in order: read-facts, write-the-batch, check-the-batch-words, draft-the-posts, approve-the-batch, set-the-posts-to-go, confirm-the-at-its-time-send, read-results, record-the-stage.
3. Read the batch it shows you (one line per post: channel, time, caption) and answer "approve all" or name the post ids to change; only your reply approves a post.
4. Check the answer of set-the-posts-to-go: a post listed under not_ready names what its place is missing; fix it and run that step again.

5. After a week the read-results step gives each post its visits and conversions; the record-the-stage step ticks social-posting on list:business-setup-checklist and lists open gaps on list:business-setup-gaps.

pour.how: Name the list you already keep for the same job and read it with records:read (its fields and row type). Run tool:pour-example-rows-into-my-list with that list as into and this kit list as kit_list: it matches each kit field to one of yours (your map, the same id, the same label, or a name in alike), pours nothing under 80% and names the fields with no home, and otherwise answers the one records:write that adds the example rows beside your own.
